frameworkEdition: FinOps Framework 2026 (published 19 Mar 2026) [CLM-FIN-003]: four domains [CLM-FIN-002] and 22 capabilities [CLM-FIN-010]; phases (Inform, Optimize, Operate) and principles are shown as context, not scored [CLM-FIN-007]

attribution.text: Adapted from the FinOps Framework by the FinOps Foundation [CLM-FIN-001, CLM-FIN-033].
attribution.changes: LTM rates each capability per scope with its own question sets, adds 'Not yet' and 'Unknown' ratings, sets default targets by complexity tier (LTM heuristics) and computes no organisation-level stage. Descriptions and maturity guidance are LTM's wording, not quotations. Not endorsed by the FinOps Foundation; not a FinOps Foundation assessment or certification [CLM-FIN-033].

maturityScale.meaning: The capability is not performed in any deliberate way.
Basic processes and KPIs, little reporting or tooling; not yet followed by all major teams; focus on easy wins (LTM paraphrase).
Understood and followed within the organisation; automation and processes cover most requirements; some difficult edge cases still open (LTM paraphrase).
Understood and followed by all relevant teams; edge cases handled; high KPIs; automation preferred (LTM paraphrase). Run is not the goal everywhere: the right level depends on the environment.
The respondent does not know. Counted as risk (gap as if Not yet) and flagged unconfirmed, with 'confirm' as the first action.
Set only by scope facts, never by an answer.
No mapped question answered; counts as not at target and lowers coverage.

capabilities.description: Collect cost, usage and related data from every account, provider and on-premises source into one store the organisation controls, completely and on time.

defaultTargets.runReason: Everything else depends on complete, timely data

maturityGuidance.notYet: Cost is seen only in provider consoles.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Some accounts exported, or data downloaded by hand.
maturityGuidance.walk: All major accounts exported automatically; known gaps are listed.
maturityGuidance.run: All accounts at least daily in a common schema (for example FOCUS) with completeness checks; private cloud and data centre costs in the same model.

AWS Data Exports: CUR 2.0 and FOCUS 1.2 [CLM-FIN-080]

capabilities.description: Assign every cost to an accountable owner (team, product or cost centre) using account structure, tags or labels and rules for shared costs, measured by cost.

defaultTargets.runReason: Unallocated spend cannot be owned, charged back or unit-costed

maturityGuidance.notYet: Allocation by cost is not measured; no allocation policy.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Allocation is measured but below 85% of spend (including below 70%); informal conventions.
maturityGuidance.walk: 85-90% allocated under a documented policy that is mostly applied.
maturityGuidance.run: More than 90% allocated; owners for every account; shared and container costs allocated by rule and reconciled to the bill.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Allocation', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-012]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
Allocation bands adopt the Foundation's sample goals (70 / 85 / >90%) [CLM-FIN-124, CLM-FIN-035]
FinOps Foundation sample allocation goals [CLM-FIN-035]

capabilities.description: Give engineering, product and finance the cost views they need, ideally self-service and filtered to their scope, on a regular schedule.

defaultTargets.runReason: Many consumers of cost data at this scale

maturityGuidance.notYet: No regular cost visibility outside the central team.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Periodic reports on request; one or two report types.
maturityGuidance.walk: Self-service for some groups; three or four report types on schedule.
maturityGuidance.run: Self-service for engineering, product and finance; all five report types (cost by owner, forecast, anomalies, unit cost, commitment coverage and utilisation).

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Reporting & Analytics', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-013]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
Report count rule (LTM heuristic) [CLM-FIN-125]

capabilities.description: Detect unexpected cost changes quickly, route them to the owner and explain and resolve them.

defaultTargets.runReason: Absolute cost of an undetected spike scales with spend

maturityGuidance.notYet: Increases are found on the invoice and cannot reliably be explained.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Static budget or threshold alerts only; explaining an increase takes weeks.
maturityGuidance.walk: Automated detection on major accounts, reviewed at least weekly; explained within a few days.
maturityGuidance.run: Automated detection on all accounts, routed to the owner, triaged within one business day and explained the same day; outcomes recorded.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Anomaly Management', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-014]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
Anomaly thresholds (LTM heuristic, consistent with Foundation descriptions) [CLM-FIN-123]

capabilities.description: Estimate and approve the running cost of new workloads and major changes before they go ahead, and compare with actuals after launch.

maturityGuidance.notYet: Running cost is not estimated before changes.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Occasional estimates.
maturityGuidance.walk: Estimates required for major changes.
maturityGuidance.run: Estimates required and automated in the delivery pipeline, compared with actuals after launch.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Planning & Estimating', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-015]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]

capabilities.description: Predict future spend from business drivers and planned changes, review it with finance and track how far actuals differ.

maturityGuidance.notYet: No forecast, or actuals differ by more than 20% on average per quarter.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Last year plus a percentage; variance 10-20%.
maturityGuidance.walk: Trend plus known changes, reviewed quarterly; variance 5-10%.
maturityGuidance.run: Driver-based forecast reviewed monthly with finance; variance within 5%.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Forecasting', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-016]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
Forecast variance bands adopt the Foundation's sample goals (<20 / <10 / <5%) [CLM-FIN-126, CLM-FIN-037]

capabilities.description: Set budgets per owner, alert when they are at risk and review variances against forecasts.

maturityGuidance.notYet: No budgets for cloud spend.
maturityGuidance.crawl: One central budget.
maturityGuidance.walk: Budgets for major owners with alerts.
maturityGuidance.run: Budgets per owner with alerts, variances reviewed monthly and linked to forecasts.

LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
AWS Budgets [CLM-FIN-085]

capabilities.description: Agree a small set of FinOps measures with targets, review them with leaders and compare them with published data (never presented as peer benchmarks).

maturityGuidance.notYet: No agreed measures.
maturityGuidance.crawl: A few metrics, used ad hoc.
maturityGuidance.walk: A KPI set reviewed quarterly.
maturityGuidance.run: A KPI set with targets, reviewed monthly by executives and compared with published data.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'KPIs & Benchmarking', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-018]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
Foundation sample goals usable as published KPI context [CLM-FIN-035]

capabilities.description: Express cost per unit of business output (customer, transaction, inference) and use it in pricing, product and architecture decisions.

maturityGuidance.notYet: Cost to serve is not known.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Unit cost calculated once or ad hoc; AI known only as a total.
maturityGuidance.walk: Unit costs defined and reported quarterly.
maturityGuidance.run: Unit costs for key products trended monthly and used routinely in pricing, roadmap and architecture decisions, including per AI use case.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Unit Economics', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-019]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]

capabilities.description: Make expected cost and unit cost a required criterion in architecture reviews and in placing workloads across public cloud, private cloud and data centre.

maturityGuidance.notYet: Cost is not considered in design or placement.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Discussed informally.
maturityGuidance.walk: Required for major designs.
maturityGuidance.run: Required with a cost model and compared with actuals after go-live.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Architecting & Workload Placement', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-020]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
2026 capability changes (Architecting & Workload Placement) [CLM-FIN-010]

capabilities.description: Match the resources used to the resources needed: remove idle resources, schedule non-production, rightsize and modernise, tier storage, tune containers and GPUs, and design data transfer for cost.

maturityGuidance.notYet: Recommendations rarely reviewed; resources run 24/7; idle resources never removed.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Ad hoc reviews and manual clean-ups.
maturityGuidance.walk: Quarterly reviews with some action; schedules and lifecycle policies for some teams.
maturityGuidance.run: Monthly reviews tracked to verified savings as normal engineering work; idle clean-up, scheduling, storage lifecycle and container tuning automated.

Azure Advisor [CLM-FIN-092]

capabilities.description: Pay less per unit of usage through commitment discounts, negotiated agreements and Spot capacity, managed as one portfolio with utilisation and expiry tracked.

maturityGuidance.notYet: No commitments bought; list prices only.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Ad hoc purchases by individual teams; renewals reactive.
maturityGuidance.walk: Central portfolio reviewed at least quarterly; commitments in a register.
maturityGuidance.run: One central portfolio sized from forecasts, utilisation and expiry managed continuously, staggered terms, Spot the default for tolerant workloads with automated interruption handling.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Rate Optimization', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-022]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
Rate Optimization covers commitment discounts and Spot [CLM-FIN-009]
Foundation sample coverage goals, shown as KPI context only [CLM-FIN-036]

capabilities.description: Know which software and SaaS is licensed, used and renewing, with owners, and right-size entitlements, including licences used in cloud.

maturityGuidance.notYet: No inventory of subscriptions or licence entitlements.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Partial list; entitlements known but not tracked.
maturityGuidance.walk: Major vendors covered and tracked.
maturityGuidance.run: Complete, usage-based inventory with renewals planned; entitlements tracked and optimised per workload.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Licensing & SaaS', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-023]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
State of FinOps 2026 scope shares (SaaS, licensing) [CLM-FIN-045]
Azure Hybrid Benefit [CLM-FIN-095]

capabilities.description: Use carbon and energy data alongside cost in optimisation and placement decisions.

maturityGuidance.notYet: Carbon and energy data not considered.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Reported, not used.
maturityGuidance.walk: Used for major decisions.
maturityGuidance.run: Used routinely, with targets.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Sustainability', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-024]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]

capabilities.description: Connect technology spend to business strategy: show the board that spend delivers the value in its business case, make cost, speed and value trade-offs explicitly, and write cost efficiency into objectives.

maturityGuidance.notYet: Value of cloud spend not shown; cost efficiency not in objectives.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Anecdotal evidence; informal objectives.
maturityGuidance.walk: Evidence by project; cost efficiency in leadership objectives.
maturityGuidance.run: Quantified, trended evidence; trade-offs decided at an executive forum; cost efficiency in team and leadership objectives.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Executive Strategy Alignment', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-025]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]

capabilities.description: Run FinOps as a standing practice: an accountable owner with a mandate and sponsor, a regular review with engineering and finance, and optimisation work planned in backlogs.

defaultTargets.runReason: A standing practice is needed at this scale

maturityGuidance.notYet: No one accountable; no regular review; finance interprets the bill alone.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Accountability shared and unclear; reviews only when budgets are exceeded.
maturityGuidance.walk: A named part-time owner; quarterly reviews; optimisation items created but often deprioritised.
maturityGuidance.run: A named FinOps lead or team with a written mandate and executive sponsor; monthly team and executive reviews; optimisation work prioritised with features and tracked to verified savings.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'FinOps Practice Operations', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-026]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]

capabilities.description: Set and enforce the rules that guide technology spend (mandatory tags, allowed regions and sizes, budget guardrails, account boundaries), preferably as policy as code.

defaultTargets.runReason: Guardrails must be automated across many teams

maturityGuidance.notYet: No cost policies; production and non-production share accounts.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Policies in some accounts; partly mixed environments.
maturityGuidance.walk: Detective (audit-mode) policies with follow-up; environments separated within shared accounts.
maturityGuidance.run: Preventive policies on all accounts; production and non-production strictly separated.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Governance, Policy & Risk', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-027]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
AWS Organizations tag policies [CLM-FIN-088]
Azure Policy tag definitions [CLM-FIN-093]

capabilities.description: Give engineers, product owners and finance staff role-based FinOps training and recognise cost improvements.

maturityGuidance.notYet: No FinOps training.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Occasional sessions.
maturityGuidance.walk: Training for some groups.
maturityGuidance.run: Role-based training for all three groups; recognition built into team routines.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'FinOps Education & Enablement', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-028]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]

capabilities.description: Reconcile provider invoices to cost data, feed finance systems and show back or charge back cost to business units.

maturityGuidance.notYet: Cost absorbed centrally; invoices not reconciled to cost data.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Rough percentage splits; manual, partial reconciliation.
maturityGuidance.walk: Showback with budget accountability; monthly reconciliation and BI integration.
maturityGuidance.run: Automated chargeback with monthly journal entries; automated reconciliation and integration with ERP and planning.

basis.citation: FinOps Framework capability 'Invoicing & Chargeback', adapted under CC BY 4.0 [CLM-FIN-029]
LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
FOCUS 1.4 Invoice Detail dataset [CLM-FIN-008]

capabilities.description: Periodically assess the FinOps practice against a framework and act on the results.

maturityGuidance.notYet: Never assessed.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Informal views only.
maturityGuidance.walk: Assessed once and partly acted on.
maturityGuidance.run: Assessed at least annually with a tracked improvement plan.

LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]

capabilities.description: Select FinOps tools and services against requirements and integrate them (data, allocation, anomaly, commitment management, automation of routine actions).

maturityGuidance.notYet: No FinOps tooling.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Native consoles and spreadsheets.
maturityGuidance.walk: Tools for most needs, some integration.
maturityGuidance.run: An integrated tool set selected against requirements, with routine actions automated.

LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]
OpenCost (example open-source option) [CLM-FIN-110]

capabilities.description: Work with IT asset management, IT financial management, procurement, security, sustainability and architecture on shared data and decisions.

maturityGuidance.notYet: No contact with related disciplines.
maturityGuidance.crawl: Informal contact.
maturityGuidance.walk: Joint work with some disciplines.
maturityGuidance.run: Joint processes and shared data with most disciplines.

LTM default targets by complexity tier (DESIGN.md 3.4) [CLM-FIN-121]

materiality.note: Kubernetes counts when cluster spend is 10% or more of compute; AI counts with any GPU or model-serving spend, or AI API spend of 5% or more of in-scope spend. Applied only when the inputs exist; otherwise a selected scope counts as material.
